oneOf.description: Part 1 of the SMPTE 12M standard defining the structure and encoding of SMPTE timecode used for identifying individual video/audio frames.
Part 2 of the SMPTE 12M standard providing metadata rules, clarifications, and additional conventions for SMPTE timecode usage.
MIDI Time Code (MTC), a musical time‑synchronization format representing SMPTE‑style time positions using MIDI messages.
International standard for unambiguous date and time representation, including calendar dates, times, time offsets, and combined formats.
A strict Internet profile of ISO 8601 defining timestamp formats used widely in web protocols and JSON APIs.
Linear Time Code — SMPTE timecode encoded as an audio‑like waveform for frame‑accurate synchronization in audio/video systems.
Vertical Interval Time Code — SMPTE timecode embedded in the vertical blanking interval of a video signal for frame labeling.
Ancillary Time Code (LTC variant) — packetized SMPTE LTC stored in the ancillary space of HD‑SDI streams.
Ancillary Time Code (VITC variant) — packetized SMPTE VITC embedded in the ancillary data space of HD‑SDI streams.
IRIG‑B — a widely used Inter‑Range Instrumentation Group timecode format for precise time‑of‑day distribution in instrumentation and aerospace systems.
